project.name: MA Creation
project.description: Full-stack Learning Management & DRM Protected Video Streaming Platform

playbackLocked.description: Set true if screen recording is detected

Plan.description: Pricing packages that gate course and service access

Course.description: Curriculum containing video lectures, tied to a Plan and Category

plan.description: Users who paid for this plan gain access

Video.description: Lecture videos stored in MinIO S3 and served via AES-128 HLS

Payment.description: Razorpay order transactions and entitlement records

RefreshToken.description: Cryptographically hashed refresh tokens supporting multi-device login

WatchLog.description: Per-user watch duration counter for anti-abuse limits

authenticationFlow.step1: Client sends POST /api/auth/login with { email, password } and header 'x-client-platform: MOBILE_ANDROID'.
authenticationFlow.step2: Backend verifies password using Argon2, generates short-lived Access Token (15m JWT) and long-lived Refresh Token (7d).
authenticationFlow.step3: Mobile receives both tokens directly in JSON. Store securely using flutter_secure_storage.
authenticationFlow.step4: Client passes 'Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>' for all authenticated requests.
authenticationFlow.step5: Upon receiving 401 Unauthorized, Client calls POST /api/auth/refresh with { refreshToken } to receive a new pair of tokens.

coursePurchaseFlow.step1: Client lists available plans via GET /api/catalog/plans.
coursePurchaseFlow.step2: Client selects a plan and calls POST /api/payments/order with { planId, name, email, phone }.
coursePurchaseFlow.step3: Backend generates a Razorpay Order and returns { keyId, order: { id, amount } }.
coursePurchaseFlow.step4: Flutter app launches Razorpay Checkout SDK.
coursePurchaseFlow.step5: Upon success, Razorpay SDK returns { razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature }.
coursePurchaseFlow.step6: Client sends verification payload to POST /api/payments/verify. Backend validates HMAC SHA256 signature and marks payment 'paid'.
coursePurchaseFlow.step7: User immediately gains access to all courses tied to this plan in GET /api/courses/mine.

videoPlaybackAndDrmFlow.step1: Client requests video list via GET /api/courses/:courseId/videos.
videoPlaybackAndDrmFlow.step2: Before playback, Client requests a token via POST /api/videos/:videoId/playback-token.
videoPlaybackAndDrmFlow.step3: Backend verifies that User owns the course plan and has not exceeded max watch multiplier limit (e.g. 2x duration).
videoPlaybackAndDrmFlow.step4: Backend creates PlaybackSession and returns { url: '/api/videos/:videoId/hls/manifest.m3u8', token, expiresAt }.
videoPlaybackAndDrmFlow.step5: Client video player fetches manifest. Inside the manifest, player requests the AES-128 decryption key from GET /api/videos/:videoId/key (passing Bearer token).
videoPlaybackAndDrmFlow.step6: During playback, Client sends heartbeat events every 15-30s to POST /api/videos/:videoId/watch-event with { token, watchedSeconds } to update server watch quotas.
